## Summary

Describe the change, affected rule IDs, and expected behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran the offline suite and included results.
- [ ] Added/updated a regression or agent scenario for changed rules.
- [ ] Distinguished automated checks from unrun/manual agent evaluations.
- [ ] Preserved approval, privacy, live URL, and score-comparability boundaries.

## Sources and compatibility

List inspected primary sources and agent/CLI versions where relevant.
Describe unavailable checks or remaining limitations.

## Authorship

- [ ] Changes are original and contributed under MIT; no third-party skill content copied.
